Archi

[edit]

Letter

[edit]

ии (ii) (lower case, upper case Ии)

  1. The twenty-fifth letter of the Archi alphabet, written in the Cyrillic script.

Yakut

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Unknown.

Noun

[edit]

ии • (ii)

  1. hoop, rim (of, say, a barrel)
    Synonym: эргимтэ (ergimte, “circle”)
Derived terms
[edit]
  • эргийэр ии (ergiyer ii, “orbit”, noun)

Etymology 2

[edit]

Expressive sound.

Interjection

[edit]

ии • (ii)

  1. Expresses disdain, humiliation, or reproach.
  2. alas, oh
